descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S04 「一条要点、十二条要点和一条 500 字符的要点，重新保存后都还在」 One point, twelve points and a 500-character point all survive a re-save

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; …（TFA-92590 AC 4；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital patient seeded with 12 manual points (one of them 500 characters, one a single character 'K'); Nursing Home resident seeded with exactly one point

When Type a pre-round note and Save Note in each chart; reopen

Then Both stored lists are identical to the seed after Save Note (ids, order, text, source), including the 500-character point and the one-character point 'K'

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Data identity only, from backendChecks: rounding:get / snf:get importantPoints before and after Save Note == the seed (ids, order, text, source) (U3, T5). Whether every card is reachable by scrolling and the long point is shown whole is a visual check in S20: an accessibility snapshot includes off-screen and clipped text, so it is not decided here. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
